en: A standard block and tackle with four pulleys can lift a 400-newton load with only 100 newtons of effort force.
The coefficient of static friction between rubber tires and dry concrete is about 0.9, but drops to 0.1 on wet ice.
Because the Moon's gravity is one-sixth of Earth's, a person who weighs 120 pounds on Earth would weigh only 20 pounds on the Moon.
Earth's magnetic north pole is currently moving towards Siberia at a speed of about 55 kilometers per year.
Electrical signals travel through copper wires at about 200,000 kilometers per second, which is roughly two-thirds the speed of light.
Visible red light has a wavelength of about 700 nanometers, while visible violet light has a much shorter wavelength of 400 nanometers.
Sound travels through air at 343 meters per second, but it travels over four times faster through water at 1,480 meters per second.
Water requires 4.18 joules of heat to raise the temperature of one gram by one degree Celsius, nearly ten times more than iron.
A 1,000-kilogram car moving at 20 meters per second has 200,000 joules of kinetic energy, four times its energy at 10 meters per second.
A single AA alkaline battery stores about 10,000 joules of chemical energy, enough to power a small LED flashlight for roughly 50 hours.
A wheelchair ramp with a slope of 1:12 means that for every one centimeter of vertical rise, the ramp extends twelve centimeters horizontally.
To escape Earth's gravity completely, a rocket must reach an escape velocity of 11.2 kilometers per second, or about 40,000 kilometers per hour.
